Share card hint: Opens your device share sheet — choose WhatsApp, pick a contact, then tap Send. The file uses the format selected above (PDF, PNG, JPG, or DICOM).
Share two step hint: Browsers need two taps: first prepare the file (it may take a moment), then open the system share sheet so WhatsApp can receive the attachment.
Share file ready: File ready — tap “Open share sheet” below.
Share text sheet opened: Share sheet opened — the file was saved to Downloads. Pick WhatsApp or another app; attach the file from Downloads if it did not attach automatically.
Share text only attach hint: The file was saved to your Downloads folder — attach it manually in the app you choose.
Share fallback no api: This browser does not support sharing files. The export was downloaded — open WhatsApp and attach it from your Downloads folder.
Share fallback cannot attach: This browser cannot attach this file type to the share sheet. The export was downloaded — open WhatsApp and attach it from your Downloads folder.
Failed to copy image to clipboard: Failed to copy image to clipboard
Film sheet hint: Uses up to {{capacity}} images from the current series ({{total}} available). Exported as one DICOM/PDF/image.
Layout export single: Exports what is shown in the current viewer layout (single pane).
Layout export multi: Exports all {{count}} images in the current layout ({{cols}}×{{rows}} grid), exactly as on screen.
